description:
Retype issue ids in the issue, claim, label, event and bulk-update commands.

## Background

`commands/issue.rs` holds 25 production issue-id references and 4 raw-id signatures, `commands/claim.rs` 26 references and 5 signatures, and `commands/labels.rs`, `commands/events.rs`, `commands/bulk_update.rs` and `search.rs` a few each. `CommandExecutor::claim_next` lives at `commands/issue.rs:774`, and the query engine builds issue ids in its tests (`query_engine/evaluator.rs:85`, `query_engine/mod.rs:81`). Integration tests call `update_issue_state` 22 times and `update_issue` 16 times, with `&String` arguments.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No struct field, enum field or function parameter in `commands/issue.rs`, `commands/claim.rs`, `commands/labels.rs`, `commands/events.rs`, `commands/bulk_update.rs`, `search.rs` or `query_engine/` holds an issue id as `String`, `&str` or `Vec<String>`; each uses `IssueId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Executor methods in this family take `&IssueId` and resolve no prefixes; callers that hold full ids, such as templates, batch creation and tests, pass them directly.
- [hard] REQ-03: No production `IssueIdPrefix` parse and no production `resolve_issue_id` call remains in this family's files.
- [hard] REQ-04: Code in this family, its unit-test modules included, uses issue ids only through `as_str()`, `short_id()`, `Display`, `Debug`, `Clone`, `PartialEq`/`Eq`, `PartialOrd`/`Ord`, `Hash` and serde, so it compiles unchanged once `IssueId` is the validated newtype.

## Notes

`crate::domain::identity::IssueId` is at this point an alias for `String`, and the `IssueIdStaging` trait gives it `short_id()`. Retyping to the alias is compiler-neutral, so this change is checked by its criteria rather than by type errors; a later change replaces the alias with the validated newtype and the compiler then reports any site missed here. Parameters are retyped outside-in: the CLI and server entry points already resolve ids, and callers in this family are retyped before the functions they call in inner layers.
title: Issue lifecycle commands carry typed issue ids
